FOREWORD 

This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards^ after the draft finalized 
by the Jute Mill Machiner^^/ Accessories and Spare Parts Sectional Committee, had been 
approved by the Textile Division Council. 

The need to formulate standard on this subject has been felt in order to provide guidance to the 
manufacturers of bobbin rail boss for jute spinning frame. This standard would ensure the 
manufacture of bobbin rail boss of acceptable quality. 

For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with^ 
the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be 
rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960 'Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised)*. 
The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value shall be the same as that of 
the specified value in this standard.

IS 13711 : IMt 



Indian Standard 



TEXTILE MACHINERY AND ACCESSORIES - 

BOBBIN RAIL BOSS FOR JUTE SPINNING 

FRAME - SPECIFICATION 



1 SCOPE 

This standard prescribes the requirements of 
bobbin rail boss for use in jute spinning frame. 

2 REFERENCES 

The following Indian Standards are necessary 
adjuncts to this standard: 



IS No. 

210 : 1978 

2500 
< Part 1 ) 



Title 
castings ( third 



1973 



Grey iron 
revision ) 

Sampling inspection tables : 
Part 1 Inspection by attri- 
butes and by count of defects 
( first revision ) 



3 MATERIAL 



Bobbin rail boss shall be manufactured from 
grey cast iron conforming to grade FG 220 of 
IS 210 : 1978. 

4 DIMENSIONAL REQUIREMENTS 

4.1 Nominal Dimensions 

These shall be in accordance with the agree- 
ment between the manufacturer and the 
purchaser. In the absence of any agreement 
these shall be declared by the manufacturer. 

4.2 Tolerances 

The nominal dimensions shall be subject to the 
following tolerances ( see Fig. 1 ): 

Dimensions Tolerance, mm 

Outside diameter of flange, Z), ±0'25 

Flange face thickness, B ±0125 



Taper bore ± 015' 

Recess diameter, D^ + 0-25 

+ 0-35 

Outside diameter of boss, Di + 

- 0-25 

4.3 Geometrical Requirements 

4.3.1 Parallelity of flange faces shall not exceed 
0075 TIR. 

4.3.2 Squareness of flange face with respect to 
taper bore shall not exceed 0-075. 

4.3.3 Surface finish of 
within 1'6MCLA. 

5 MARKING 



flange faces shall be 



5.1 Each bobbin rail boss shall be legibly 
marked with the indication of the source of 
manufacture. 

5.1.1 The bobbin rail boss may also be marked 
with the Standard Mark. 

6 PACKING 

The bobbin rail boss shall be suitably packed 
to ensure complete protection from rust. 



7 SAMPLING AND 
CONFORMITY 



CRITERIA FOR 



Unless otherwise agreed to between the 
purchaser and the manufacturer to ascertain the 
conformity of the bobbin rail boss for jute 
spinning frame to the requirements of this 
specification, single sampling plan with Inspec- 
tion Level I and Acceptance Quality Level 
( AQL ) of 1-5 percent given in Tables 1 and 2 
of IS 2500 ( Part 1 ) : 1973 shall be followed.
